Nala's held line across the bank killed two climbers; then, rising, she was seen and ran.

event: You surge up from the brambles, spear in hand. A goblin sees you and shrieks; the band shrieks back.

memory.fact: Rising from the brambles, Nala is seen by every goblin on the bank, and they shriek it to the band.
Rising from the brambles, Nala is seen by every goblin on the bank, and they shriek it to the band.

event: You run for the ford; the maul-bearer roars, and four climbers and a slinger come after you.

memory.fact: As Nala fled for the ford, the maul-bearer roared; the four climbers and a slinger ran after her.
As Nala fled for the ford, the maul-bearer roared; the four climbers and a slinger ran after her.
Short of seven dead, the maul-bearer sends the climbers and a slinger after a fleeing foe.

event: A sling whirrs; your foot catches a root; the stone takes you between the shoulders. You go down.

changes.note: A sling stone between her shoulders throws her down

memory.fact: The sling stone between Nala's shoulders knocked her breath out and left her back burning.
The sling stone between Nala's shoulders knocked her breath out and left her back burning.
A sling stone took Nala between the shoulders and threw her down on the trail below the bank.
A sling stone took Nala between the shoulders and threw her down on the trail below the bank.

event: Breath gone, back burning. In your close sense the spear goblin is three paces off.

memory.fact: As she falls, the LV 3 club is eight paces behind the spear, the two LV 2 knives fifteen.

event: You swing low for its neck as it stabs down; your back seizes, the blade goes wide.

changes.note: Two earnest strokes on the dark trail carry toward Spearmanship LV 6

memory.fact: Stabbing down, the spear goblin leans its throat low, in reach of a sweep from the ground.
The spear goblin's hide stops at its chest; its throat is bare.

event: Its spear tears a shallow gash in your side as you jerk aside.

changes.note: The spear goblin's point tears her side

memory.fact: Nala's slash from the ground missed; the spear goblin's stab tore a shallow gash in her side.
Nala's slash from the ground missed; the spear goblin's stab tore a shallow gash in her side.

event: You roll to your feet, spear crosswise. The club goblin bursts past and swings at your head.

memory.fact: Nala got to her feet, spear in hand, as the club goblin burst past the spear and swung at her head.
Nala got to her feet, spear in hand, as the club goblin burst past the spear and swung at her head.

event: You feel it coming and throw yourself aside; it thuds into the trail where your head was.

memory.fact: A club goblin swinging overhand at a head leaves its own body open beneath the arm.
A goblin's overhand club swing, once missed, leaves it off balance for a breath.

event: You run. A stone hums past and cracks off an oak.

memory.fact: Nala dodged the club by her close sense and fled; a second sling stone missed, cracking off an oak.
Nala dodged the club by her close sense and fled; a second sling stone missed, cracking off an oak.

event: Your sense lays the trail out a stride ahead, every root and rut; your feet land true.

memory.fact: Running the dark trail, Nala's sense lays it out a stride ahead, every root and rut.
Running the dark trail, Nala's sense lays it out a stride ahead, every root and rut.

event: Back burning, side bleeding, you run; the feet behind fall back until only your own remain.

memory.fact: Nala outran her pursuers down the deer trail, lost them in the dark, and came out by Tull's ford.
Nala outran her pursuers down the deer trail, lost them in the dark, and came out by Tull's ford.
The goblins chase while she's in sight; the spear and club tire before the light knives do.
Having lost her, the pursuers go back up the trail to the band; none comes on toward the ford.

event: Two miles through the dark, until the trees thin. Across the meadow a lantern glows in Tull's fold.

memory.fact: From where Nala fell, Tull's ford lies some two miles down the deer trail.
From where Nala fell, Tull's ford lies some two miles down the deer trail.
Tull's fold lantern shows from the Tangle's edge, across the last two hundred paces of meadow.
Tull's fold lantern shows from the Tangle's edge, across the last two hundred paces of meadow.

event: In the fold a little flame blooms in a raised hand and turns toward the trees where you stand.

memory.fact: As Nala reached the Tangle's edge, a little flame bloomed in a raised hand in Tull's fold.
As Nala reached the Tangle's edge, a little flame bloomed in a raised hand in Tull's fold.
The flame in the raised hand in Tull's fold turned toward the trees where Nala stood.
The flame in the raised hand in Tull's fold turned toward the trees where Nala stood.
Merrit, jumpy on watch, shouts once at a sound in the trees before he throws fire at it.

event: "Who's there?" Merrit's shout cracks across the meadow. "It's me, Nala!" The flame holds.

memory.fact: Shouting at the Tangle's edge by the ford carries plainly to Tull's fold across the meadow.

event: You cross at a stiff jog, hand to your side. "A full warband, twenty at least. Two big hobs."

memory.fact: At Tull's ford Nala warned Dace and Merrit of a warband of twenty, two hobgoblins, five downed.
At Tull's ford Nala warned Dace and Merrit of a warband of twenty, two hobgoblins, five downed.

event: "I think I downed five, but they chased me hard. I'm low on mana, but I can use a spear."

memory.fact: Nala came into Tull's fold hurt, blood soaking her side, low on mana but able to use a spear.
Nala came into Tull's fold hurt, blood soaking her side, low on mana but able to use a spear.

event: Dace is over the wall at once; he believes you. "Five, alone?" Merrit says, his flame hotter.

memory.fact: Hearing of a warband of twenty and two hobgoblins, Dace believes Nala at once and takes charge.
Hearing of a warband of twenty and two hobgoblins, Dace believes Nala at once and takes charge.
Merrit said he doubted she downed five alone, but readied his fire all the same.
Merrit said he doubted she downed five alone, but readied his fire all the same.
Merrit doubts she downed five alone, and says so, but he readies for a fight all the same.

event: "Aldo, take the cob to Hobb's. Bring Wren and Orla. Ride hard." Tull steps out, cudgel in hand.

memory.fact: As Nala came in hurt on day 8's night, Tull stepped out of his cottage, cudgel in hand.
As Nala came in hurt on day 8's night, Tull stepped out of his cottage, cudgel in hand.
Dace sends Aldo on Tull's cob to Hobb's, to fetch Wren and Orla; the ride takes a quarter hour.
Roused by the news, Tull wets the cottage thatch from the well and sets buckets by the walls.

event: Aldo runs for the cob and is gone. "How bad is that? Can you stand a fight?"

memory.fact: Dace sent Aldo on Tull's cob for Wren and Orla, then asked Nala if she could stand a fight.
Dace sent Aldo on Tull's cob for Wren and Orla, then asked Nala if she could stand a fight.

event: "I'm not at my best, but I can fight. Better if I get some mana back first."

memory.fact: Nala told Dace she can fight, though not at her best, and better with some mana back.
Nala told Dace she can fight, though not at her best, and better with some mana back.

event: "Then rest by the fold wall. I'll rouse you when Orla comes, or at the first torch."

memory.fact: Dace bids Nala rest by the fold wall; he'll rouse her when Wren and Orla come or at the first torch.
Dace bids Nala rest by the fold wall; he'll rouse her when Wren and Orla come or at the first torch.
Dace means to hold the fold's gate himself, with Merrit's fire to meet the torches at the ford.
Merrit has fire enough for several fireballs tonight, and means Nala to see them.

event: You sit against the cold stones, spear across your knees. Merrit paces; Tull stands silent.
Hoofbeats within the hour: Aldo on the cob, Wren and Orla jogging behind.

memory.fact: Wren and Orla, fetched from Hobb's, reach Tull's fold within the hour, before the strike comes.
Wren and Orla, fetched from Hobb's, reach Tull's fold within the hour, before the strike comes.

event: "Oh, Nala." Orla's hands glow rose over the gash. It draws shut; the ache in your back melts away.

changes.note: Orla closes her gash and eases her back; Human LV 6 has raised her strength

memory.fact: Orla can close Nala's gash and ease her back once she reaches Tull's fold.
Orla can close Nala's gash and ease her back once she reaches Tull's fold.
Wren and Orla came to Tull's fold with Aldo; Orla closed Nala's gash and eased her back.
Wren and Orla came to Tull's fold with Aldo; Orla closed Nala's gash and eased her back.

event: You rest on. Slowly the warmth creeps back: two-fifths full. The half moon sinks behind the Tangle.

changes.note: Resting by the fold wall, her warmth creeps back

event: Near midnight Wren hisses: "There." Torches flare at the Tangle's edge: a dozen, more.

memory.fact: Near midnight Wren spotted a dozen and more torches flare at the Tangle's edge across the ford.
Near midnight Wren spotted a dozen and more torches flare at the Tangle's edge across the ford.
Unbroken, the hobgoblins regather the band and come on, warier, to the edge near midnight.
The strike is now some fourteen goblins, the wounded LV 6 among them, and both hobgoblins.

event: "I can take at least two with my skill before they reach us. The hobs?" "The hobs."

memory.fact: Nala told Dace she could take at least two of the warband with her skill before they reached them.
Nala told Dace she could take at least two of the warband with her skill before they reached them.
Dace says take the hobgoblins: goblins whose big ones fall run, as every hand at the hall knows.
Dace says take the hobgoblins: goblins whose big ones fall run, as every hand at the hall knows.
If the maul-bearer falls, the spear hobgoblin horns retreat and the band goes back with him.

event: "Merrit, fire on the ford. Wren, the cottage roof. Orla, behind me. Tull, Aldo: hold the fold gate."

memory.fact: Dace put Merrit on the ford, Wren on the cottage roof, Orla behind him, Tull and Aldo at the gate.
Dace put Merrit on the ford, Wren on the cottage roof, Orla behind him, Tull and Aldo at the gate.
Wren picks out the two hobgoblins among the torches by their size, one with a maul, one a spear.
Merrit means to throw his first fireball into the torches as they splash across the ford.

event: A shriek goes up; the torches surge out at a run and pour down into the ford, a river of fire.

memory.fact: At the edge they light torches, rush the ford, and go for the fold and the cottage thatch.
Grakk's strike moves dark, and lights torches only at the meadow's edge, to fire the farm.

event: In the middle two shapes stand a head taller: one with a maul, one with a spear.

memory.fact: The strike's torches surged into Tull's ford, the two hobgoblins a head taller amid them.
The strike's torches surged into Tull's ford, the two hobgoblins a head taller amid them.
The hobgoblins come on behind the goblins' torches, the maul-bearer bellowing them forward.

event: Merrit's fire bursts against the front of the rush and scorches it. The rest come on fast.

memory.fact: Merrit's fire burst against the front of the goblin rush on Tull's fold and scorched it.
Merrit's fire burst against the front of the goblin rush on Tull's fold and scorched it.
From the ford the rush gets within forty paces of the fold in some forty breaths, to it in fifty.

event: Forty paces. A line across the maul-bearer's eyes; it roars and reels, blood through its fingers.

changes.note: A rend across the maul-bearer's eyes

memory.fact: By their own torches the running hobgoblins' heads show plain from the fold, bobbing as they run.

event: The second line goes through the spear-bearer's skull. It drops like a felled tree. Hobgoblin LV 10.

changes.note: A rend through the spear hobgoblin's skull
The LV 10 hobgoblin: race experience
The LV 10 hobgoblin: class experience

memory.fact: Nala's rend killed the spear hobgoblin through the skull, and laid the maul-bearer's eyes open.
Nala's rend killed the spear hobgoblin through the skull, and laid the maul-bearer's eyes open.

event: Proficiency gained: [Rift Rend LV 6]. The rush breaks; goblins fling down torches and flee.

changes.note: The skull-cut through the spear hobgoblin raises Rift Rend to LV 6

memory.fact: Killing the spear hobgoblin through the skull raised Nala's Rift Rend to LV 6.
Killing the spear hobgoblin through the skull raised Nala's Rift Rend to LV 6.
The strike broke at Tull's, flung down its torches and fled back over the ford into the Tangle.
The strike broke at Tull's, flung down its torches and fled back over the ford into the Tangle.
The flung torches gutter out in the dew-wet meadow; none of them catches the grass.

event: The blind maul-bearer stands alone, swinging at air, then lurches toward the bleating fold.

memory.fact: Left alone and blind in the meadow, the maul hobgoblin roars, swings, and lurches toward the fold.
Left alone and blind in the meadow, the maul hobgoblin roars, swings, and lurches toward the fold.
The blind maul-bearer swings at sound; a quiet foe coming from aside is hard for it to meet.
Lurching blind toward the bleating, the maul-bearer shows plain in the light of its fallen torches.

event: You find it by sense and lay the line; it drags, you pour in more, and it lands across its chest.

changes.note: A rend laid by sense on the blind maul-bearer

memory.fact: The fleeing goblins do not stop until Grakk's camp, and none comes back for the maul-bearer.

event: The maul thuds into the grass; the hobgoblin topples after it. Hobgoblin LV 12. Your warmth is gone.

changes.note: The last rend empties her warmth
The LV 12 hobgoblin: race experience
The LV 12 hobgoblin: class experience

memory.fact: Nala's last rend, run low across shoulder and chest, killed the blind maul hobgoblin in the meadow.
Nala's last rend, run low across shoulder and chest, killed the blind maul hobgoblin in the meadow.
His strike broken and two hobgoblins lost, Grakk holds his camp and sends out no raid for a while.

event: A dull ache behind your eyes. Far off across the ford, the last shrieks fade into the Tangle.

memory.fact: Broken, the strike flees up the trail to camp, hobgoblins too; none comes on to Tull's that night.
Only the two hobgoblins died at Tull's; their heads, ears and cores are there for the taking.

event: Tull walks out of the fold gate, grips your hand hard, and holds it a long moment.

memory.fact: With the strike broken, Tull gripped Nala's hand hard and said nothing.
With the strike broken, Tull gripped Nala's hand hard and said nothing.

event: Merrit stares at the two dead hobgoblins. "Five, she said," he mutters. "Alone."

memory.fact: Merrit muttered, "Five, she said. Alone." after the last hobgoblin fell.
Merrit muttered, "Five, she said. Alone." after the last hobgoblin fell.
Seeing two hobgoblins felled from forty paces, Merrit goes quiet and does not doubt her aloud again.

event: Dace sets his shield down. "Two hobgoblins. Ilsa will want to see them. Walk in with us at dawn?"

memory.fact: Dace asked Nala to walk in with the Four at dawn, so Ilsa can see the two hobgoblins.
Dace asked Nala to walk in with the Four at dawn, so Ilsa can see the two hobgoblins.
Dace holds that the hobgoblins' bounty is Nala's, her kills, and will say so to Ilsa.
